steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Miss Stone! Is it true we're heading straight toward a Catastrophe?

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Even if we're outside of town, shouldn't we be getting warnings from Wrankwood's intercity net? Why haven't we gotten anything on our terminals?

steps.name: Unlucky Stagehand
steps.text: So all those times I lost signal weren't just my bad luck—

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Someone sabotaged our comms!

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Enough with the baseless speculation!

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Baseless?

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: I found a few strips of paper in your office. When you put them together, they form a Catastrophe forecast from Trimounts University... and a storyboard.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Signed by you, Greta Stone. What are you planning?

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Let me see that.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: No one told me about any of these new scenes. Aren't I supposed to be the director of photography?

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: And why do we need to set up cameras at the edge of the plate? There aren't any sets out there... wait, I get it.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: What the Ford, Greta?! You planned all this! Why did you hide it from us?

steps.name: Unlucky Stagehand
steps.text: Calm down, Abner... Maybe she just didn't have time to update you on the new schedule, in the chaos following Shelly's death...

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: You're still defending this lunatic? She wants to get the plate close to a Catastrophe to film it! Putting all of our lives at risk!
The furious cameraman smashes his equipment to the ground.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: I've had enough of this shit! I'm leaving this place NOW!

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: As impulsive as ever, Abner.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Real persuasive coming from a goddamn lunatic!

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: How much of your own money did you put into this, to make up for the box office losses of that movie five years ago? You're counting on this one for your comeback after all those failed investments...

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: So if this film flops, are you gonna use Dalton and Shelly's accidents too, the same way you used that girl who fell to her death?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Calm down, Abner.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I see you've been closely following my career, but what about yours? How many films have you worked on in the last three years? This is the first, isn't it?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Sloppy, short-tempered, unprofessional... Camera equipment is expensive—what other film crew would even give you a chance? You wouldn't even make it as a freelance event photographer.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: You want to leave? Fine by me. I'll even waive the contract penalty, for old times' sake. But where do you think you can go, Abner?

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Does it matter? Worse comes to worst—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: What, you leave town? Change jobs? Spare all those poor camera lenses from your abuse? Say whatever you like, swear as many oaths as you want—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: If that's really how you feel, why are you even here?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: So are you leaving? Or not?
Abner does not pick up the equipment, nor does he leave. He stands unmoving in silence, caught between his life and his past.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Have you calmed down?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Look on the bright side. If we do finish this movie, maybe you'll win a few more awards for Best Cinematography. Feel free to reject me once the other offers start rolling in.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Dream as big as you want, Greta.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: I stopped dreaming five years ago.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Now, these latest two accidents have reminded some of us of the tragedy we've experienced together, and led others to be taken in by half-true rumors.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: So I'd like to take this chance to lay everything out on the table, for the sake of our cooperation on the rest of this project.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Most of the crew here also worked with me five years ago, when an unfortunate accident occurred due to aging equipment—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: A young actress, Laura, was killed.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Feel free to look up the police reports. Everything is out in the open. I have nothing to hide.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: But the only connection that incident has to my decision to film a Catastrophe is that it taught me a lesson.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: What we lack is not skill. It's courage.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Of course, by no means have I disregarded your safety.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Before our plate departed central Wrankwood, I visited expert Catastrophologists at Trimounts University.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I obtained a detailed report, and tested the data in the plate's navigational system multiple times. The studio plate will keep a safe distance from the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Access to the emergency escape landboats will remain unrestricted. Any staff member who feels their life is in danger may use them at your own discretion.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: And I will be the last to leave this plate.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: If there are no further questions. Dismissed.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Not you. Stay.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: M-Miss Stone...

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: I-I won't apologize for telling everyone!

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: No need to be anxious. I just wanted to know how you got the documents.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Like I said, I did it myself—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Don't lie to me. You have no talent for it, and I have no time.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: ...I'm obliged to protect the identity of my informants.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Disturbing the peace of the studio is a violation of the second and fifth clauses of your contract. Would you like to see the outcome of that reflected in your bank account?

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: But there are exceptions made under exceptional circumstances—

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: (Whispers) It was Lucian.
Greta casts her gaze across the crowd and scattered equipment, and sees him standing outside the chaos.
The Feline receives Greta's cold gaze unperturbed, and gives her a nod.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: You said Michael came to see you last night?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: But we kept going after Shelly left, didn't we? We watched a Yanese jiangshi movie next. ...Wait, come to think of it, you did leave the room for a little while.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Michael sent me a message on my terminal. He said he was waiting for me in the studio, because he had some important questions.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have left in the middle of our movie night. Please don't be mad...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I'm mad alright...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Tippi...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I'm mad you didn't ask me to come with you.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: What if Michael tried to assault you? That sleazebag wouldn't know morals or self-restraint if they hit him in the face. Or, what if he was frustrated about the shoot getting interrupted and wanted to take it out on you? You're, like, a magnet for bullies.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Hey, I don't bully girls.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Yeah right. You're an asshole even to Marion, never mind other girls.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: Heh, even the kid sees right through you.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I wanted to ask you to come, but he said I had to come alone...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I've been in a few film crews. I could guess it was some kind of prank. But I didn't want you to get caught up in it too.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Molly...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I've been in Wrankwood way longer than you have, and I know way more jobs. Next time you meet someone like that, just tell me, and I'll help you think of a way to get back at them.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Well, what now, Detective? With Moira's testimony, can I take it I've been cleared of suspicion?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Maybe it really was a coincidence that he ran into Shelly.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: We saw how she was when she left last night...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Like she wasn't all there, right?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Yeah. Maybe she was at her limit...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Thank you for testifying on my behalf, Moira.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I know it took courage. After all, Tip might be even more protective of you than your actual sister...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Speaking of which, is she still working as an actress? If she's as cute as you... do you think you could give me her number? Maybe I could help her land a role or two.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: Seriously? Even after getting accused of murder?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Come on, babe, I'm just trying to lighten the mood.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: Whatever. Don't change the subject.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: You still haven't told me why you were looking for Moira.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Yeah, I wanna know too.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I think they deserve to know, Michael.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Moira, don't—

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: He asked me if there was a way to sneak off the plate.
